home.hero.title: Leer om het belangrijke te beveiligen.
home.hero.subtitle: Een moderne universiteit voor cybersecurity, talen en full-stack-ontwikkeling. Oefen op echte systemen. Denk in bewijzen. Bouw een carrière die ertoe doet.
home.programs.heading: Three disciplines. One connected campus.
home.programs.sub: Start where you are. Stack skills across disciplines. Graduate with a body of work you can defend.
home.method.heading: Not content. Capability.
home.method.sub: Our learning model is designed around the work itself: understand the system, practice the decision, explain the evidence.
home.method.step1.title: Learn the mental model
home.method.step1.text: Short lessons, clear language and a curriculum that connects theory to systems.
home.method.step2.title: Practice in safe labs
home.method.step2.text: Work on isolated scenarios where curiosity is encouraged and mistakes are recoverable.
home.method.step3.title: Submit your evidence
home.method.step3.text: Build a record of decisions, artifacts and reflections—not just a percentage.
home.method.step4.title: Get human feedback
home.method.step4.text: Mentors and peers help you calibrate your thinking. AI recommends; people stay accountable.

home.community.heading: Build a future worth defending.
home.community.sub: Join a cohort of curious people learning to make technology more trustworthy.

home.pathway.languages.title: Languages & culture

home.pathway.fullstack.title: Full-stack development
home.pathway.fullstack.desc: Design, ship and defend production-grade applications with a curriculum built around real systems, not toy exercises.

campus.hero.title: The whole campus,
campus.intro: Four original programs, twenty weeks each, with readings, guided labs, quizzes, glossaries and evidence-based assessment. No account, no tracking, no paywall.
campus.nav.label: Campus sections
campus.programs.heading: Four disciplines. One body of evidence.
campus.programs.sub: Each program runs twenty weeks. The public course page is the complete reader: lessons, quiz, lab, rubric, glossary and final assessment. Mark your progress locally and it stays on this device.
campus.tools_sub: The campus ships offline-first instruments for triage, observation, search and evidence. They use synthetic data and never touch a real network.
campus.sources_sub: Every program links to repositories, standards and APIs that were checked when the material was written. No dead links, no invented citations.
campus.evidence_sub: Assessment follows a 30 / 30 / 40 model: weekly participation, formative quizzes and a final project with evidence. The campus records what you can defend, not just a percentage.
campus.disclaimer: Secure T is an open study campus. It does not claim official accreditation, university degree validity or industry certification. Progress is stored only in your browser.

progress.intro: No account, no email, no tracking. This page reads and writes the same local key as the static campus, so what you mark here appears there and the other way around.
progress.in_localstorage: in localStorage. Never sent to a server.
progress.reset_confirm: Erase all progress saved in this browser?
progress.import_error: Could not read the file. It must be valid JSON.
progress.complete: Program complete in your local record. The real credential requires human review.
progress.local_note: This record is local and does not constitute an official academic transcript. To keep it, export the JSON before clearing browser data. You can import it on another device.
progress.locked_tip: Unlocks after completing weeks, quiz and lab.
mentor.intro: A study companion that asks before it answers. It never invents grades, accreditation or citations. If the online model is not configured, you get an honest fallback and a pointer back to the material.
mentor.privacy: Chat is not saved on the server or in localStorage. The limit is 10 queries per minute. For legal, health or personal data matters, consult a person.
mentor.empty_sub: For example: “I am in week 3 of Defense. What evidence shows I understand the NIST 800-61 cycle?”.
mentor.placeholder: Ask about a week, a lab or a security decision…
mentor.footer: Secure T · study mentor with safeguards
